newsitem.title: NORWAY: Phillips sees Ekofisk restart at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Phillips sees Ekofisk restart at weekend.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum said on Thursday it expected to resume oil production at the North Sea Ekofisk field at the weekend.
Spokesman Sander Bull-Gjertsen said work was in progress to replace a section of a 30 inch oil pipeline, which sprang a gas leak on Tuesday.
"All the equipment is at the field but the welding will take some time. We hope to restart production on Saturday or maybe in the worst case scenario on Sunday," Bull Gjersten said.
The 350,000 barrel per day Ekofisk development was shut in early on Tuesday after the gas leak was detected.
Output from third party fields -- British Petroleum's Gyda and Ula and Amoco's Valhall and Hod -- and the Statpipe gas line was uninterrupted by the shutdown.
